subject: Operational readout and uptick motion — renewal Q4 check

From: Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@cloudwave.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Usage spike & renewal check — quick readout attached

Kim, Ben —

Thanks for the quick help earlier in the week. We ran an internal review and attached a one-page performance snapshot that shows a ~2.8x spike in token consumption for our recommendation pipeline over the last 30 days. Latency is fine for single-request flows but the batched reranker is showing 35–60ms additional tail due to longer sequences.

We're approaching our renewal on 2027-01-15 and want to understand options for:
- short-term burst credits or headroom to smooth the upcoming campaign (marketing A/B test on 2027-01-10)
- a modest term increase (12 -> 18 months) if unit economics line up
- any immediate tuning you can recommend (batching/quant profiles) we can apply before the campaign

Attached: cloudwave_performance_snapshot_Q4.pdf (overview).

Can we do a 30-min operational readout next week? Ben, looped you for ops detail.

—Sam
Sam Irwin
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudWave
sam.irwin@cloudwave.com

On Sat, 12 Dec 2026 at 09:24 AM Sam Irwin <sam.irwin@cloudwave.com> wrote:
> Kim, Ben —
>
> Thanks for the quick help earlier in the week. We ran an internal review and attached a one-page performance snapshot that shows a ~2.8x spike in token consumption for our recommendation pipeline over the last 30 days.

Hi Sam — thanks for the snapshot. We reviewed the file and dug into the last-week traces. Quick summary up-front:

- Primary driver: increase in candidate scoring sequence length after a UI change (average tokens per request up ~150 -> 380).
- Secondary driver: slightly more aggressive reranker hyperparams in experiments.
- Impact: expected token spend delta aligns with your report (~2.6–3x depending on request mix).

Immediate actions we can do this week:
1) Apply temporary prefix/KV caching for the static context in the scoring pipeline (should cut ~15–25% of tokens on repeating prefixes).
2) Suggest reverting the reranker temperature/beam settings for the A/B test window — we can provide diffs and a small canary.
3) If short-term headroom is required, we can offer a one-time burst credit and an interim 30% committed uplift for 90 days to cover the campaign.

I've copied Marissa for renewal playbook coordination (terms + timeline). Ben, can you prepare a concise ROI sketch (tokens vs monthly cost with the uplift) and attach the latency logs you pulled?

Available for a 30-min slot on Wed 12/16 09:00 or Thu 12/17 14:00 PT. Which works?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive — Renewal & Growth
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

On Mon, 14 Dec 2026 at 10:14 AM kimberly_park@redwood.com wrote:
> Ben, can you prepare a concise ROI sketch (tokens vs monthly cost with the uplift) and attach the latency logs you pulled?

Attached: redwood_response_latency_logs.csv and uptick_pricing_model.xlsx (stubbed pricing workbook).

Sam — rough numbers from our model (ballpark to align expectations):
- Current monthly bill (average last 3 months): ~$36,000
- Projected monthly spend under campaign (baseline config): ~$92,000
- With temporary caching + revert reranker tuning: ~$68,000 (25% saving vs campaign baseline)
- Proposed 90-day uplift (30% committed increase) reduces unit price enough to make the campaign ~15% cheaper than the baseline campaign cost if commit accepted.

Operational notes:
- Latency: median unchanged, p95 for batched reranker improved by ~12ms after kernel-level mem alignment (log attached).
- Risk: if sequence length increases further, the delta scales linearly — recommend enabling early throttles for experimental cohorts.

Next steps I suggest we take if you want to proceed:
- Short-term: enable caching + revert reranker on a 10% canary today, monitor 48h.
- Commercial: sign a 90-day uplift addendum (30% capacity bump) to run Jan campaign; we'll provide 20% one-time burst credit on top of the uplift.

I'll be on the Wed/Thu slots Kimberly suggested — prefer Wed 09:00.

—Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

- Technical mitigation: caching + reranker revert will be applied to 10% canary immediately and expanded to 100% after 48h with acceptance metrics.
- Commercial mitigation: 90-day uplift (30% committed increase) + 20% one-time burst credit to cover campaign peaks.

Commercial asks / timeline:
1) CloudWave to confirm acceptance of the uplift addendum by EOD 2026-12-22. We will then send a DocuSign envelope for signature (link below).
2) Procurement (procure@cloudwave.com) to confirm any PO requirements; if you need a revised SOW we can produce one same-day.
3) Tech: Ben to push the canary changes by 15:00 PT today; Marissa to own rollout and health gating.

Docs attached and links:
- Uptick pricing workbook (uptick_pricing_model.xlsx) — includes blended unit rates and projected spend table.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=ABCDE-12345
